title: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
abstract: arXiv:2611.20196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. translated_title: 用于连续手部运动学估计的自由度查询Transformer：自我中心视觉与前臂高密度表面肌电信号的自适应融合
translated_abstract: 连续且准确地估计人体手部运动学不仅对直观的人机交互非常重要，而且对于捕获细粒度的人类操作示范也至关重要，这些示范可以为具身智能数据集和灵巧机器人学习提供动作监督。然而，在变化的运行条件下，单一传感模态可能不足以实现可靠估计。我们提出了一种不束缚手指的多模态框架，用于从自我中心RGB图像和128通道前臂高密度表面肌电信号连续回归20个手部关节角度。该框架结合了基于Vision Transformer的视觉编码器、基于Transformer的肌电编码器以及自由度查询Transformer融合解码器。为了考虑视觉和肌电线索在不同关节自由度和输入条件下信息量的差异，解码器为每个自由度分配一个独立的可学习查询……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种自由度查询Transformer融合解码器，通过为每个关节自由度分配独立的可学习查询来自适应融合自我中心视觉与前臂高密度表面肌电信号的互补信息，实现无需束缚手指的连续手部关节角度精准估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a DoF-Query Transformer fusion decoder that adaptively fuses egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG by assigning a separate learnable query to each joint DoF, enabling finger-unencumbered continuous estimation of 20 hand joint angles.
